finalText:
Build is clean. The error was on line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — `maxRetries` was set to the undefined variable `retries` instead of reading it from the `env` object. Changed it to `env.retries || 1` to pull the value from the passed-in config with a fallback default.

The three warnings stay (deprecated API, unused export, circular import), but those don't block the build — the actual link error is gone and it exits with code 0.
